summary: Tested customer-data protection (rider masking/call/arrived, rider deny-list, history masking, masked phones for manager, record-open log + threshold alert, owner-only campaigns/broadcasts, device & hours enforcement, one-click deactivation/session revocation) and HR onboarding (seeded templates, versioning, assign→423 gate, e-sign w/ PIN + PDF, file ACL, request-resign, scan upload, departure PV) via new pytest suite (17/17 pass) + UI (rider app course detail, rider/console OnboardingGate, Équipe Employés/EmployeeFile/Sécurité, Paramètres Documents RH, manager Clients/Statistiques/nav). Found and FIXED one critical bug: punch-required roles (manager/sales/stock/CM) with pending docs were dead-locked (onboarding endpoints were not PUNCH_FREE → 428, gate falsely showed 'Tout est signé'). Remaining: several manager-accessible endpoints still leak full customer phones; rider can read /api/notifications with customer names+phones; staff login has no brute-force lockout.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: returned 428 'Pointage d'arrivée requis' for punch-required roles (sales/manager/stock/CM) → employee could never sign; frontend gate rendered first so user was stuck. Added '/api/onboarding/me', '/api/onboarding/files/' to PUNCH_FREE in deps.py.

Return FULL customer phone numbers to the Gérante (e.g. '+225 07 85 55 58 88'), bypassing the masking applied to /api/customers & /api/orders and the per-record access log. Requirement: phones masked everywhere for non-owner; full number only when opening a customer record (logged).

Rider passes RIDER_PREFIXES ('/api/notifications') and receives the global console notification feed incl. customer full names + phone numbers (new orders, abandoned carts). Should be denied for riders (add to RIDER_DENY) or riders should only use /api/me/notifications.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout for staff login (only rider-pin and customer code have it). Console 4-digit PIN login iterates all users with no rate limit; also the attendance kiosk UI prints 'Codes démo: 1234 (admin), 2222 (manager)...'.
Manager can regenerate a customer's login code (and gets it + WhatsApp link) → can log in as the customer and see full data; consider owner-only or log it as a record opening.
Now fails (403 'Réservé au propriétaire') because campaigns are owner-only per new spec. Update the old test (or confirm CM role should lose campaigns).
Expiry computed as 30*months days (12 months = 360 days, not 1 year).
No such route (405) - fine; rider deny verified on /api/orders, /orders/{id}/invoice, /deliveries, /customers, /customers/top.

ui_bugs.issue: load() .catch(() => setDocs([])) masks API errors and shows 'Tout est signé · merci !' while the user is still blocked (this is how the 428 deadlock appeared). Show an error/retry state instead.
'Segments & campagnes' still visible in Gérante nav (/console/segments); spec says campaigns owner-only. /console/campagnes correctly redirects.
'Vendeuse' role checkbox appears twice in 'Rôles concernés'.
Placeholder 'Rechercher code, cliente, téléphone…' still mentions phone search although riders must have no customer search/phones.

issues: Members table inside half-width card overflows horizontally at 1920px; after interacting, names are cut on the left ('Ouattara', 'onaté').
Native browser date/time pickers used (departure-date, sec-start/sec-end) instead of shadcn components.
Expiry shown without year ('expire le 13 oct.') right after 'Signé le 18 oct.' → looks already expired; show the year.
Sign button enabled before checkbox/signature/PIN; validation only via toast (works, but disabling would be clearer).

action_items: Mask customer phones (or strip them) for non-admin in /api/deliveries, /api/delivery-sessions, /api/whatsapp-outbox, /api/invoices (+ /orders/{id}/invoice), /api/reviews, /api/abandoned-carts, /api/waitlist
Deny riders on GET /api/notifications (global staff feed with customer names/phones) – add to RIDER_DENY
OnboardingGate: handle /onboarding/me errors (don't show 'Tout est signé' on failure)
Hide 'Segments & campagnes' from Gérante nav (or split segments vs campaigns)
Update test_role_access_limited.py CM campaign test to expect 403 (owner-only)
Add brute-force lockout to /api/auth/login and /api/auth/login-pin; remove demo PIN hint from kiosk
Remove duplicate 'Vendeuse' in SecurityTab roles; show year on expiry dates; fix Team table overflow
critical_code_review_comments: deps.PUNCH_FREE lacked onboarding paths while frontend renders OnboardingGate before PunchGate → deadlock (fixed).
Phone masking is applied per-endpoint (customers, customers/top, orders) – a central response-level sanitiser for non-admin (or masking in shared serializers) would avoid the many remaining leaks.
privacy_cfg and onboarding _gate are in-process caches (30s) – fine for single worker, inconsistent with multiple workers.
server.py is >5000 lines; customers endpoints should move to a router.

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested privacy/onboarding tests (17/17) after fix; 3 extra data-leak findings

rca of the issue: Onboarding deadlock: get_user() checks onboarding (423) before punch (428) but /api/onboarding/me* were in ONBOARDING_FREE only, not PUNCH_FREE; for punch-enabled roles the gate's own calls hit 428, OnboardingGate catch() set docs=[] and displayed 'Tout est signé'. Repro: create sales user, assign doc, login → gate shows nothing to sign. Mitigation applied: added paths to PUNCH_FREE; verified sales user signs then reaches PunchGate.
